soft_thresholds.kind: cooperative soft thresholds: set a stop flag; they do NOT prevent further allocation or execution

RLIMIT_AS.note: 限的是地址空间，不等于 RSS；作为兜底偏保守。越界为任意位置的 MemoryError

RLIMIT_CPU.note: 软限发 SIGXCPU（可捕获→有序停机），硬限 SIGKILL

hard_backstop.kind: kernel-enforced RLIMIT; independent of any in-process check

stop_grace.kind: upper bound on work after a stop is requested

resources.deadline_basis: absolute wall-clock deadline on the whole response (socket timeout alone is a per-read inactivity timeout, not a completion deadline)
resources.peak_basis: kernel VmHWM (measured high-water mark, not a sample)

gate_stats.note: http_reserved 是预算口径，占用后即使请求未发出也不退还；只有 http_sent 可当作实际网络调用量。
